  1. common.definitions
  2. StationDefinition

Uses of Interface
common.definitions.StationDefinition

Packages that use StationDefinition
Package
Description
common.controller
Controllers of the shared JMT GUI model layer, including the model checker that validates a model before its simulation is started.
common.definitions
Definition of the JMT simulation model data structure (CommonModel, StationDefinition, ClassDefinition, ...) shared by JSIMgraph and JSIMwiz.
common.definitions.parametric
What-if (parametric) analysis definitions of the JMT GUI layer: parametric model modifiers and their checking logic, as described in the JSIM chapters of the user manual.
common.editors
Swing cell editors used by the JMT GUI tables to edit model parameters.
common.panels
Panels of the JMT simulation model wizards: source, sink, queue, delay, fork, join, router, logger, class switch and related parameter panels used by JSIMgraph and JSIMwiz.
common.panels.parametric
Panels of the what-if (parametric) analysis configuration dialogs of the JMT GUI tools.
jsimgraph.definitions
Definition interfaces of the JSIMgraph model data source, shared between the graph editor and the model layer.
jsimwiz.definitions
Definition interfaces of the JSIMwiz textual wizard model layer.
jsimwiz.panels
Panels of the JSIMwiz wizard: the textual, step by step interface for the JSIM simulation engine described in the user manual.
